data.long_meaning: The name Beerendra is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bhee' meaning 'Lord' and 'Randhra' meaning 'Sacred Mountain'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Indra, who is known as the god of rain, thunderbolts, and mountains. The name Beerendra carries the meaning “Lord of Sacred Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Beerendra usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of sacred mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
